source.title: Sharing the Faith
source.description: This human grasps for Elune's light, but his sight is clouded. Would you assist him?
source.objective: Meditate on Elune, then pray with the kneeling human to share your meditations.
source.completion: The Light works its blessings through you, <name>. Honor it by continuing to share your wisdom with supplicants you meet in your travels.
